description: Database client and SQL studio for Orca with real-time SQL syntax diagnostics and an opt-in dual-role AI SQL Assistant (inline ghost completion, inline statement edits, Fix with AI, and EXPLAIN plan analyzer). Browse schemas, edit and import data, design tables, and run SQL, MQL, or Redis queries over SSH and TLS across 12 built-in engines (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, CockroachDB, ClickHouse, Redis, LibSQL/Turso, Cloudflare D1, MSSQL, Oracle, MongoDB) plus 7 local BYOD drivers.

settings.title: Max Rows Ceiling
settings.description: Maximum number of rows returned by a query

settings.title: Query Timeout (seconds)
settings.description: Maximum execution time before cancelling a query

settings.title: AI Inline SQL Autocomplete
settings.description: Enable AI inline SQL autocomplete (ghost text) and inline statement edits (Alt+\). When off, only local schema and keyword completion runs.

settings.title: AI Provider Format
settings.description: API protocol used by the configured AI provider.

settings.title: AI Base URL
settings.description: Root URL of your chosen AI provider for inline autocomplete (and EXPLAIN & Fix when Sync AI Provider Across Tasks is enabled).

settings.title: AI Model
settings.description: Fast model for inline SQL autocomplete (and EXPLAIN & Fix when Sync AI Provider Across Tasks is enabled).

settings.title: AI Max Completion Tokens
settings.description: Maximum tokens requested for each inline SQL suggestion.

settings.title: AI EXPLAIN & Fix Max Tokens
settings.description: Maximum tokens for AI EXPLAIN analysis and Fix with AI responses (higher values prevent truncation in Vietnamese/CJK).

settings.title: EXPLAIN & Fix Response Language
settings.description: Language used by AI for EXPLAIN execution plan analysis and Fix with AI explanations. SQL and DDL stay in standard SQL.

settings.title: Sync AI Provider Across Tasks
settings.description: Share one AI provider, base URL, model, and API key across both Inline Autocomplete and EXPLAIN & Fix. Disable to configure each task independently.

settings.title: AI EXPLAIN & Fix Assistant
settings.description: Enable AI execution plan analysis (EXPLAIN) and Fix with AI error repair.

settings.title: AI EXPLAIN & Fix Provider Format
settings.description: API protocol used for EXPLAIN analysis and Fix with AI when Sync AI Provider Across Tasks is disabled.

settings.title: AI EXPLAIN & Fix Base URL
settings.description: Root URL of the AI provider used for EXPLAIN analysis and Fix with AI when not synced.

settings.title: AI EXPLAIN & Fix Model
settings.description: Instruction or chat model used for EXPLAIN analysis and Fix with AI when not synced.
